baslik: Which washing machine does AI recommend in Turkey? Bosch vs Arçelik vs Vestel #shorts
aciklama:
Asked about washing machines in Turkey, AI named Bosch in 54 of 72 live-search answers. ChatGPT mentioned Vestel, a major Turkish brand, in just 1 of 24 answers.

Highlights
• Brands named (72 answers): Bosch 54, LG 34, Beko 33, Samsung 33, Arçelik 30, Siemens 25, Vestel 18.
• Vestel: ChatGPT 1/24, Claude 15/24, Perplexity 2/24, Gemini (from memory) 5/20.
• Change the question, the winner changes: on service and spare parts, Arçelik and Beko 6/6; for an app-controlled machine, LG 6/6.
• Google Shopping (Turkey, "çamaşır makinesi"): Bosch 1st, Beko 8th, LG 15th, Arçelik 20th; Vestel not in the top 20 listings.
• Most cited sources: eniyilerden.com (15 answers), indirimist.com (12), bosch-home.com.tr (10).

Questions this video answers
• Which washing machine brand does AI recommend in Turkey? Bosch, most often.
• Do the AIs agree? No: Claude named Vestel 15 times, ChatGPT once.
• Does Google Shopping match AI? Bosch is first in both; Arçelik is 20th on Shopping.
• Where does AI look? Best-of list sites and Bosch's own website.

Method: Nov 19–22, 2026, questions asked in Turkish from Turkey. ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity answered 12 questions twice each with live web search (72 answers); Gemini answered from memory (20 answers). Google Shopping data: Nov 27, 2026, Turkey. Limited sample; not representative of the whole market.

These are the AI's answers. Independent measurement. We have no sponsorship or partnership with any brand shown.
